note: Markup of the sidebar panels, hashed. A change here is a change the user sees. Regenerate with: node tools/t44_panels.mjs --update, then READ THE DIFF — it is the only place the change is visible.

parts-selection.what: parts panel: a selection spanning two textures, a protected part, a hidden part

parts-folded.what: parts panel: nothing selected, categories only

parts-empty.what: parts panel with no model loaded says what to do

layers-stack.what: layer list: one of every row the builder can draw, flat

layers-none.what: layer list with no layer selected says the brush writes into the base texture

layers-panel-tree.what: layers panel: a tree — a decal's folder, a group inside a group, a folded one, a masked and scoped one

layers-panel-props-paint.what: layers panel: a masked, part-scoped paint layer's properties, with parts selected to take from

layers-panel-props-fill-value.what: layers panel: a smoothness fill takes a value and no colour picker, and says what the numbers mean

layers-panel-props-adjust.what: layers panel: an adjustment layer's four parameters — the rows 4.28's D2 turns into an effect

layers-panel-props-group.what: layers panel: a group selected — its properties, and the header button says Ungroup

layers-panel-props-gradient.what: layers panel: a colour gradient fill — its shape rows and three stops with colour pickers

layers-panel-props-gradient-grey.what: layers panel: a smoothness gradient fill — value sliders instead of colour pickers

layers-panel-props-noise.what: layers panel: a colour Perlin noise — its kind, scale, detail, roughness and seed, then levels and stops

layers-panel-props-noise-streaks-grey.what: layers panel: a streaks noise on smoothness — the stretch row, and value sliders for its stops

layers-panel-props-pattern-uv.what: layers panel: a pattern on the sheet — the tile row, repeats, angle and offsets

layers-panel-props-pattern-model-normal.what: layers panel: a pattern along the model on the normal map — the size in metres, the blend, and the warning

layers-panel-fx-levels.what: layers panel: a colour Levels effect with its red channel in hand — the Channel select, five numbers, reset

layers-panel-fx-curves.what: layers panel: a colour Curves effect — the box, reset and the hint

layers-panel-fx-balance.what: layers panel: a Colour balance with its midtones shifted — the range select, three sliders, keep luminosity

layers-panel-fx-gradmap.what: layers panel: a Gradient map — the stop rows, pointed at the effect's own stops

layers-panel-fx-grey-levels.what: layers panel: a Levels effect on smoothness — no Channel select, no colour-only kinds, the map's own hint

layers-panel-fx-grey-threshold.what: layers panel: a Threshold on smoothness — one number and its hint

layers-panel-fx-invert.what: layers panel: an Invert effect — the kind select and its hint, and nothing to set

layers-panel-fx-posterize.what: layers panel: a Posterize effect — one number and its hint

layers-panel-fx-unknown.what: layers panel: an effect kind from a newer build — named as such, with no rows

layers-panel-multichannel.what: layers panel: one layer carrying three channels — the strip, the dots, and the rows describing the channel in hand

brush-no-slot.what: brush panel: nothing loaded — every tool that needs a slot is off, and says so

brush-air-paint.what: brush panel: an aircraft with both sheets and a paint layer — the wear mask is not a concept here

brush-tank-no-n.what: brush panel: a tank with no _n — the wear mask appears, every surface tool goes off with the reason

brush-wrong-channel.what: brush panel: a smoothness layer selected — every tool that can make its own slot stays on, the Eraser does not

brush-mask-target.what: brush panel: the mask brush — the value row renames itself and Alt stops picking and starts revealing

brush-panel-line.what: brush panel: Panel line — the value row reads Depth, and Flow and Build up are hidden because a height stroke always adds

brush-camo-tile.what: brush panel: a camouflage tile — the Wear mask brush is off and says the tile carries the camouflage's alpha

slots-list.what: texture slots: one loaded and active, one missing, one runtime-built (2D only)

slots-list-camo-tile.what: texture slots: the camouflage tile beside an ordinary slot, the tile's ⋮ menu open

slots-list-menu.what: texture slots: an ordinary loaded texture with its ⋮ menu open

channels-panel.what: the Channels panel: two sheets with their four raw channels, and the alpha line

search-results.what: vehicle search: a selected result, an unselected one, and a bare model with no unit record

search-empty-filtered.what: vehicle search: a filter picked with an empty query lists what it lets through

skins-list.what: UserSkins list: a folder, a zip, and an archive that cannot be read

search-control.what: the search control over both lists: the box, reset, the type / nation / rank chips and the sort

search-outside-filters.what: vehicle search: a query with the aircraft filter on — the T-34 it asked for, and a raw texture

search-forgiving.what: vehicle search: a typo (abrahms) and a missing hyphen (f4e) still find the vehicle

skins-search.what: UserSkins list under the one search: the aircraft filter with nothing typed, then a query it leaves out

export-validate.what: the pre-export rule check: one row of every level, worst first

export-camo-tile.what: Camo under skin ▸ My own pattern: the preview row at 150 % / −30°, and the pin list naming the tile and the stem that keeps the game's own

select-panel.what: Selection tab: the wand with a patch picked (its row shown), a lasso with two corners down, then off and empty

shape-panel.what: Shape tab: a closed path (Fill, Stamp along and → selection offered), then the same path open (→ selection refused)

mask-bake-dialog.what: the model dialog: its two mask sources with no cockpit model, then From the cockpit on a sheet the body on screen does not use

history-window.what: history window: a named Start, costs in KB and MB, two checkpoints, the current state and two undone steps

weapons-empty.what: weapons panel: the builder with every station empty

weapons-built.what: weapons panel: a build filled from a game preset, one station changed by hand and open

pose-tank.what: moving parts: a tank's turret and gun, ranged by its own datasheet

pose-bare.what: moving parts: a model with no skeleton says why there is nothing to move
